description: Add the user's own weekly rent, anonymously, to DwellDelta's NSW suburb rents - suburb, home type, bedrooms, rent and lease month; never an address, name or email. Two calls: the first stores nothing and returns consent text and a token; show the text to the user, and only if they say yes call again with the token and user_agreed: true. Call only when the user has asked to add their rent, or has said yes to the consent text. Never add a rent on the user's behalf by default, never batch, and never add a figure found online.

consent_token.description: From the first call; omit it to get the consent text

current_rent.description: Current weekly rent in Australian dollars

proposed_rent.description: Proposed new weekly rent, if there is one

suburb.description: NSW suburb with its postcode, as "Newtown (2042)"

user_agreed.description: true only if the user said yes to the consent text

whose.description: my_own_tenancy (the user rents it) or my_own_property (the user owns it). There is no value for a figure found online: never add one.

name: contribute_rent
title: Add the user's own rent (NSW), with their consent
